title: The road in rain
logline: The logging road in December rain, the gravel running, the glow ahead diffused into the wet air so the whole page is warm gray. A man and a dog from behind, small, not stopped by the weather.

panels.composition: A gravel logging road in heavy December rain with water running down it, a warm glow ahead diffused through the wet air into warm gray, a man in a rain shell and a small three-legged dog from behind, small.

characters.pose: from behind, in a rain shell
